attributes.name: CSS class naming approach
attributes.definition: The style of class names used in the page markup: utility-framework classes versus hand-written semantic/custom names.

values.definition: Classes are hand-written, descriptive or semantic names, with no utility-framework patterns.
Classes follow a utility-first framework pattern (e.g., many small single-purpose classes).
Both semantic custom classes and utility-style classes appear.
Markup uses few or no classes.

attributes.name: Class usage density
attributes.definition: How many class names are applied across the markup.

values.definition: Few, compact class names are used.
A moderate number of class names are used.
Elements typically carry many class names.

attributes.name: Inline style usage
attributes.definition: Whether styling is applied via inline style attributes in the markup.

values.definition: Inline style attributes are used in places.
Inline styles are absent or negligible.
